title: PSG-22 Conforming Attached Moss Growth
visual_intent: A fresh purpose-built stone garden finial is imported from STL. A digest-bound surface carrier places several low-profile moss mounds as a separate closed geometry asset, visibly attached to curved source regions without mound overlap.
expected_visual_signal: Hero and grazing views must show real mound silhouette, parallax, and contact with the stone. Attachment-base, source-triangle provenance, clearance, and exact-repeat views must explain why the added geometry is closed, attached, separated, and deterministic.
rejection_condition: Reject if growth is material-only, the source changes, attachment bases do not penetrate the carrier surface, components overlap, any growth edge is open or nonmanifold, provenance is incomplete, or repeated artifacts differ.
